summary.title: SecureNova AI Identity Thread Model
summary.description: SecureNova is an AI platform containing human users, AI agents, OAuth M2M clients, LLM APIs, RAG pipeline services, MCP servers, and internal APIs. This threat model analyzes identity, authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, and AI-specific security threats using STRIDE.

diagrams.title: SecureNova AI Identity Data Flow

threats.title: AI Agent Identity Spoofing
threats.description: An attacker may impersonate the AI agent by  obtaining or forging agent credentials or tokens, allowing unauthorized access to protected APIs and services.
threats.mitigation: Use short-lived tokens, strong agent authentication, token validation, and cryptographic identity binding.

threats.title: AI agent requesting tampering
threats.description: An attacker may modify authenticated agent requests, instructions, or identity-related data before they reach downstream services.
threats.mitigation: Use integrity protection, signed messages, strict input validation, and verification of agent requests at trust boundaries.

threats.title: AI agent privilege escalation
threats.description: A compromised or spoofed AI agent may obtain privileges beyond its intended scope and access protected internal APIs or services.
threats.mitigation: Apply least privilege, enforce scoped tokens, re-authenticate agent-to-agent requests, and deny implicit trust across boundaries.
